title: GemCraft — Faceted Gem Studio
description: Cut, color, and light a real faceted gemstone in WebGL — then save it to a gallery or share the recipe.
concept: A tiny lapidary studio: pick a cut (round brilliant, princess, emerald step, or pear), choose a gemstone color or dial in a custom hue, and tune facet density and sparkle intensity while the stone catches a twinkling two-light rig in real time. Every gem is generated procedurally by revolving a 2D cutting profile into flat-shaded facets, just like a real lapidary's lathe.
features: 4 procedurally-lathed gem cuts (round brilliant, princess, emerald step, pear)
7 gemstone color presets plus a fully custom hue slider
live facet-density and sparkle-intensity controls with real-time regeneration
save creations to a localStorage gallery with auto-captured thumbnails
PNG export and shareable recipe links encoded in the URL hash
tech: Procedural lathe geometry with flat per-facet normals

interaction.mouse: Drag to orbit the gem, scroll wheel to zoom, click cut/color swatches and sliders in the bottom panel
interaction.click: Tap cut or color buttons to change the gem; action buttons randomize, save, export, or share
interaction.touch: One-finger drag to orbit, two-finger pinch to zoom, tap controls in the bottom panel
interaction.keyboard: Arrow keys orbit the gem, R randomizes, S saves to gallery, E exports a PNG
